story_log.development: NHL announced Babcock is clear to coach after investigation into Columbus resignation in Sept 2023. Edmonton can now hire him. League investigation complete.

story_log.title: MLB announces new HR Derby format: 8 participants, 20 swings Round 1, 15 swings final rounds
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: MLB announced 2026 format changes: 8 participants, top 4 advance. 20 swings in Round 1, 15 in final two rounds. Player who homers on last swing continues until out or wins round.

story_log.title: Adley Rutschman hit in helmet by throw in ninth inning vs Mariners
story_log.development: Rutschman got hit in helmet by throw in 9th inning of Orioles-Mariners game. Seattle won 3-0. Extent of injury unclear.

story_log.title: Trea Turner exits Phillies game after hit-by-pitch on knee
story_log.development: Turner left game after getting hit by pitch on knee. Phillies concern after awkward HBP. Status unclear.

story_log.title: James Dolan tells WFAN he won't go into punitive second apron to keep Knicks intact
story_log.development: Dolan told WFAN Wednesday he will not go into punitive second apron to keep team intact for 2026-27 season. Championship glow may not prevent roster cuts.

story_log.title: Isiah Thomas questions NBA crowning Wembanyama as face of league, compares to Jordan treatment in Detroit era
story_log.development: Thomas reflected on never being league's face despite Pistons beating Bird, Magic, Jordan. Sees similar dynamic with Wemby: league choosing face isn't always about who wins most. ClutchPoints deep dive on Thomas's comments.

story_log.title: Ghana scores last-gasp winner vs Panama in 2026 World Cup group stage
story_log.development: Caleb Yirenkyi scored winner in 95th minute to give Ghana 1-0 win over Panama after 0-0 stalemate. Ghana's second World Cup win ever, first since 2010.

story_log.title: England routs Croatia 4-2 in World Cup opener behind Kane brace and Rashford strike
story_log.development: England beat Croatia 4-2 in Group L opener. Harry Kane scored twice, Marcus Rashford added late goal. Croatia led 2-0 early, England stormed back with 4 unanswered. Bellingham goal gave England lead in second half.

story_log.title: DR Congo earns first-ever World Cup point with 1-1 draw vs Portugal
story_log.development: Congo scored first World Cup goal in 52 years (since 1974 appearance) and held Portugal to 1-1 draw. Ronaldo went 90 minutes without goal, 0 shots on target, 0 assists, 1,000 minutes since last non-penalty WC/Euro goal. Thierry Henry cooked Ronaldo postgame.

story_log.title: Olivia Miles explodes for career-high 31 points on 80% shooting vs Sparks
story_log.development: Miles posted 31 PTS (career-high), 4 REB, 4 AST on 12-15 FG (80%). Only rookie this century besides Paige Bueckers with 30+ on 80+ FG%. Had 24 points in first half alone. Lynx beat Sparks.

story_log.title: Trae Young declines $49M player option, will negotiate extension with Wizards
story_log.development: Young plans to decline $48.97M player option to become FA Monday, per Marc Spears. Washington remains front runner, Young loves team and DC. Expects multiple team max interest. Will negotiate long-term extension.

story_log.title: Passan releases top 100 MLB trade deadline candidates: Skubal, Chapman, Peralta lead market
story_log.development: Jeff Passan and Kiley McDaniel published top 100 trade candidates ahead of Aug. 3 deadline. Tarik Skubal, Matt Chapman, David Peralta, Luis Arraez headlining. Will update list periodically as deadline approaches.

story_log.title: North Carolina and Oklahoma advance to College World Series Finals
story_log.development: UNC eliminated West Virginia to reach CWS Finals for first time since 2007. Oklahoma beat Georgia to advance. Best-of-3 championship series begins Saturday in Omaha.

story_log.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong homers in third consecutive game for surging Cubs
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: PCA hit leadoff homer vs Rockies, third straight game with HR. Cubs offense rolling after cycle performance two days ago.

story_log.title: Devin Booker switches from No. 1 to No. 15, honoring father and Team USA
story_log.development: Booker changing jersey number from 1 to 15 next season per Shams. Honors USA Basketball uniform and father Melvin Booker's college number. Ends 11-year run in No. 1.

story_log.title: Corbin Carroll hits go-ahead grand slam to put Diamondbacks in front vs Angels
story_log.development: Carroll crushed go-ahead grand slam in late innings as Diamondbacks rallied vs Angels. Arizona won 8-1.

story_log.title: A'ja Wilson passes Brittney Griner on all-time WNBA scoring list, fastest to 6,000 points
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 6]: Wilson posted 33 PTS, 11 REB, 5 STL, 2 BLK vs Phoenix. Only player in WNBA history to record those numbers in single game. Reached 6K points in just 278 games, fastest ever. Chelsea Gray tied WNBA single-game three-point record with 9 threes same night.

story_log.title: Sabrina Ionescu hits clutch go-ahead bucket to give Liberty win over Sky
story_log.development: Ionescu hit late go-ahead shot as Liberty edged Sky 96-95. New York wins close game to improve record.

story_log.title: Sonia Citron posts first 20/10 game of season (26-12) as Mystics beat Sun
story_log.development: Citron had 26 PTS, 12 REB, 4 AST, 12-12 FT in Mystics' 88-81 win over Connecticut. First 20/10 game of her season.

story_log.title: Royals acquire Randy Dobnak from Mariners after exercising upward-mobility clause
story_log.development: Kansas City acquired RHP Randy Dobnak from Seattle per Passan. Dobnak exercised upward-mobility clause in contract, added to 40-man roster. Will start at Triple-A Omaha.

story_log.title: MLB removes clock from Home Run Derby, switches to 20 swings first round / 15 swings final two
story_log.development: MLB getting rid of clock in Home Run Derby per Evan Drellich. Participants get 20 swings in first round, 15 in final two rounds. On last pitch of each round, keep going until they don't hit homer.

story_log.title: NBA champions Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson throw out first pitch at Yankees game
story_log.development: Knicks champions Hart and Brunson threw ceremonial first pitch at Yankee Stadium. ESPN and Jomboy Media covered moment.

story_log.title: Knicks championship parade draws massive crowds at 4am, 6 hours before start
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 11]: Knicks fans lined streets at 4am, six hours before championship parade scheduled to start. Crowd scenes went viral. HaterReport: 'Knicks fans been waiting for this their WHOLE LIVES.'

story_log.title: Olympic medalist Jenny Simpson collapses after medical episode while pacing mile group
story_log.development: Simpson collapsed after suffering medical episode while pacing mile group at event in Raleigh, NC on Tuesday per ESPN. Olympic bronze medalist and world-champion 1,500m runner. Condition unknown.

story_log.title: Golden Knights promote Ryan Craig from AHL affiliate to replace John Tortorella as head coach
story_log.development: Vegas promoted Ryan Craig (AHL affiliate coach) to lead NHL team as head coach per ESPN. Moved on from Tortorella day earlier. Quick coaching change for Knights.

story_log.title: Maple Leafs hire Jim Hiller as head coach after 93-58-24 record with Kings
story_log.development: Toronto hired Hiller as head coach per ESPN. 93-58-24 record over parts of three seasons with LA Kings. Second stint with Leafs (worked as assistant 2015-19). Hiller is 57 years old.
